title.zh: SOON因异常提现暂停svmBNB及主网跨链桥服务并展开调查
title.en: 【SOON：因异常提现暂停 svmBNB 及主网跨链服务】

current_state.zh:
SOON Foundation 表示，2026 年 10 月 31 日约 11:00（UTC），svmBNB 与 SOON 主网两座跨链桥出现异常提款活动。基金会在当日 14:00（UTC）发现异常后立即关闭桥接服务，并称目前已控制相关跨链桥，调查完成前两座桥将持续暂停运行。

在调查期间，svmBNB 与 SOON 主网之间的跨链通道被冻结，用户暂时无法通过这两条路径桥接资产。

公告未披露异常提款涉及的资产规模及具体损失。SOON 表示将根据调查进展公布更多信息。
current_state.en: SOON Foundation halted the svmBNB and SOON Mainnet bridges after detecting abnormal withdrawal activity on 31 October and says both will stay offline pending an investigation, without disclosing the scale of assets involved.

updates.detailed_summary_en: SOON paused its svmBNB and mainnet cross-chain bridge services after detecting abnormal withdrawal activity, and the foundation says it is investigating while the suspension remains in place.
updates.background_zh: SOON 是一个构建 SVM（Solana 虚拟机）Rollup 的项目，svmBNB 是其连接 BNB Chain 的跨链桥。跨链桥历来是攻击的重点目标，攻击者通常通过滥用验证者签名或消息验证路径将资金转出。
updates.background_en: SOON is a project building an SVM (Solana Virtual Machine) rollup, and svmBNB is its cross-chain bridge connecting to BNB Chain. Cross-chain bridges have repeatedly been a target of exploits, with attackers typically abusing validator signature or message-verification paths to move funds out.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件直接影响通过 svmBNB 与 SOON 主网桥接的用户与流动性；在损失规模披露之前，SOON 代币及该生态的跨链流动性面临托管与市场情绪层面的风险敞口。
updates.market_impact_en: The incident directly affects users and liquidity routed through the svmBNB and SOON Mainnet bridges, and leaves the SOON token and the ecosystem's cross-chain liquidity exposed to custody and sentiment risk until the loss scale is disclosed.
